The entire renovation journey from our very first meeting to handover, and even post-handover has been seamless.

From our first consultation, Mykel took the time to explain the entire renovation process in detail, including the timelines, milestones, and what to expect at each stage. He also gave practical suggestions for our design ideas, ensuring they were not only aesthetically pleasing but also functional and cost-effective. I was particularly impressed by his technical knowledge, attention to detail, and how organised he was, which gave us a great deal of confidence from the start.

Shortly after our meeting, he provided a comprehensive quotation with a detailed breakdown of every line item. The transparency made it easy for us to understand exactly what we were paying for and budget accordingly.

Before renovation works began, we met several times to finalise the details for carpentry, lighting, electrical works, masonry, and other aspects of the project. Every meeting was productive, and Mykel patiently guided us through each decision, offering valuable advice while ensuring the final outcome matched what we wanted. He also provided a clear project schedule and kept us informed throughout every milestone, ensuring everything stayed on track.

What stood out most was his honesty and professionalism. At no point did he try to upsell unnecessary works or products. Instead, he consistently prioritised our needs and recommended only what would genuinely benefit our home. Throughout the renovation, Mykel was incredibly responsive and accommodating. He personally visited the site regularly to ensure the workmanship met expectations and frequently sent us progress photos so we always knew how the renovation was progressing. It gave us great peace of mind knowing the project was being closely managed.

One thing that truly sets Mykel apart is his after-sales service.
